title: Intellectual Property Ownership
plainEnglish: The company may own everything you create during the internship.
counterClause: Ownership applies only to work created as part of the internship.
negotiationTip: Ensure personal projects remain your property.

title: Unpaid Overtime
plainEnglish: You may be required to work extra hours without additional pay.
counterClause: Any overtime should be compensated or mutually agreed.
negotiationTip: Ask for a maximum weekly working hour limit.

title: Immediate Termination
plainEnglish: The employer can end your internship without warning.
counterClause: Require at least seven days' notice before termination.
negotiationTip: Ask for written notice before termination.
